messages:
marta: Quick thread  provenance gating for new partner models. We need a short checklist for marketplace SKUs and a separate path for partner-managed downloads. Who owns the checklist?

sam: I can draft the ops checklist. main items: region allowlist, attestations, SI test plan, monitoring hooks. will share a template.

jules: Legal: need provenance metadata (origin, training data attest, license terms) embedded in SKU metadata. For downloads, require signed redistribution addendum + chain-of-custody doc.

kevin: Marketing: also require a short "what this model is" blurb (80-120 chars) and a permissive vs restricted badge for the tile. prevents buyer confusion.

anya: Engineering note: for downloads we need a distro manifest file that includes checksums and an expiry timestamp. we should enforce automatic revocation if partner revokes. sample manifest: ```name: model-x
version: 1.2
checksum: sha256:...
expiry: 2027-04-01T00:00:00Z```

legal-bot: Reminder: export restrictions apply to models trained with certain datasets. run quick-country-check with policy v2.

jules: Also add a short buyer questionnaire for restricted uses + destination country. If buyer flags red, deny download and offer hosted-only.

open-supplier: From our side: we prefer hosted tiles but can provide downloads under approved ent. we'll prepare provenance doc. timeline: assets + provenance pack in 3 business days.

marta: Good. Sam  can you make two SKU flows in the template: (A) Hosted tile (default) (B) Download request (sales + legal gate). outline required docs for each.

sam: Yup. I'll create Marketplace SKU template with fields: name, short-blurb, hosting-regions, badge, billing-metric, provenance-links, download-policy-link. will link to SI checklist. ETA: tomorrow.

kevin: For badges, let's use: "Hostable" (green), "Restricted Download" (amber), "No Download" (red). marketing will wire the visuals once we get the copy.

anya: Ops constraints: hosted path needs per-tenant KV cache limit and a max-seq cap. put defaults in the SKU: max_seq=2048, cache_share=0.2. these can be overridable for Dedicated.

jules: One more legal: require partner confirmation that weights are cleared for redistribution and that they own required rights. include contact email in provenance pack.

open-supplier: we'll include a signed statement. also can provide a short example inference prompt and sample outputs.

marta: Great. Action list:
- Sam: SKU template + SI checklist (tomorrow)
- Jules: provenance metadata spec + quick buyer questionnaire (EOD)
- Anya: distro-manifest schema + runtime guardrails for hosted (tomorrow)
- Kevin: badge copy and tile guidance (after blurb)
- Open-supplier: provenance pack + sample outputs (3 business days)

kevin: Can we gate listing until provenance pack is uploaded? prefer that. :lock:

jules: Agreed. Legal needs the pack before we publish. also request an email confirmation from supplier legal.

sam: I'll add a pre-publish job in the pipeline that flags missing provenance links.

marta: OK locking decision: require provenance pack pre-publish. downloads only via enterprise addendum + attestation. we'll proceed with marketplace tile flow.

open-supplier: Thanks  we'll get the pack over and confirm legal email. excited to list.

marta: Closing for now  reopen if any issues. short follow-ups in separate threads for SI testing and PR assets.

legal-bot: Note logged: provenance-gating-policy v1 applied to SKU creation.
